title: DDR4 memory controller with an AXI4 subordinate port: INCR / FIXED / WRAP bursts, narrow transfers, byte strobes by read-modify-write

regs.name: N_RMW
regs.desc: Halfword read-modify-writes (one byte strobe of two)

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: an AXI burst ended with SLVERR

notes: The AXI4 subordinate port (s_*) and the DRAM pins pass through the wrapper unchanged; the registers only read the front end's counters.

Halfword h = addr[31:1] reaches the core as haddr = {h[24:11], 7'b0, h[10:0]}: column h[7:0], bank h[10:9], row h[24:11]. The core keeps 256 columns of 16 bits, so the AXI space aliases above 512 bytes.
